feature: Create missing deployment, performance, and accessibility guides
description: The docs/README.md navigation references docs/guides/03-deployment.md, docs/guides/04-performance.md, and docs/guides/05-accessibility.md but these files don't exist. Only 2 of 5 referenced guide files are present.
workflow_rationale: This is a documentation-only task with no code changes, no service dependencies, and trivial risk. Three guide files need to be created in a new docs/guides/ directory. Files can be created independently with no dependencies.

phases.name: Create Documentation Guides
phases.description: Create the docs/guides directory and three missing documentation guides

verification.command: test -d docs/guides && echo 'Directory exists' || echo 'Directory missing'

verification.expected: File exists with substantial content (100+ lines)

subtasks.notes: Should consolidate and organize deployment information from DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md, focusing on practical deployment workflows, CI/CD setup, and common gotchas. Include pre-deployment checklist, deployment commands, post-deployment verification, and troubleshooting.

verification.expected: File exists with substantial content (100+ lines)

subtasks.notes: Should cover performance optimization strategies including: Core Web Vitals, caching patterns, build optimization (Vite chunking strategy), monitoring, and performance testing. Reference existing performance docs and deployment lessons learned.

verification.expected: File exists with substantial content (100+ lines)

subtasks.notes: Should cover WCAG 2.1 AA compliance requirements for Norwegian government services, including: touch target sizes (44px minimum), color contrast, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, ARIA labels, and automated testing with axe-core. Include practical testing methodology and verification steps.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution appropriate for documentation - 1 worker
parallelism.rationale: All subtasks are in the same phase and can be completed sequentially. Documentation tasks benefit from focused attention rather than parallelization.

acceptance_criteria: Each guide has substantial content (100+ lines)
Guides follow existing documentation patterns with table of contents, examples, and verification steps
Documentation is accurate and references correct file paths

verification_steps.name: Verify File Content
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Each file has substantial content (100+ lines)

verification_strategy.reasoning: Documentation-only change with no functional code modifications. No tests or security scanning required.

steps: Verify all three guide files exist and have meaningful content
Review each guide for accuracy and completeness
Verify guides follow existing documentation patterns
Check that file paths and commands in guides are correct
